notes.title: DLC"∀kashicbox vol.1" and "Hymeno Striker", out now!
notes.content:
[h1]DLC have been launched![/h1]
We have released the DLCs "∀kashicbox vol.1" and "Hymeno Striker"!

[h2]∀kashicbox vol.1[/h2]
This is a fan box for the "∀kashicverse -Malicious Wake-".
It contains the soundtrack of the music used in "∀kashicverse -Malicious Wake-"
It also includes an arrangement album.
[h3]Data[/h3]
[list]
[*] Disc1-2 ∀kashicverse -Malicious Wake- Original Soundtrack
[*] Disc3 ∀kashicverse Compilation Album -Amor Platonicus-
[/list]

[h2] "Hymeno Striker"[/h2]
This is a horizontal scrolling shmups featuring Hymeno, the boss character of "∀kashicverse -Malicious Wake-".
There are three stages with three difficulty levels.
At first glance, the game looks poppy and easy to play, but it's really "∀kashicverse" inside.

[h2]Bundle Set[/h2].
"Hymeno Striker" was originally included in the "∀kashicbox vol.1" set, but due to Steam's specifications, it will be released as a separate title this time.
We've prepared [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/18931/kashicbox_vol1_GameSoundtrack_pack/]a bundle set[/url], so please take advantage of it.

notes.title: "∀kashicverse -pandemonic nightmare-" is now available!
notes.content:
[h2]We have released the DLC " ∀kashicverse -pandemonic nightmare-".[/h2]
You will be able to play one extra stage of higher difficulty.

You can only play one stage.
There is no storyline or achievement text.
You must have the full version of ∀kashicverse - Malicious Wake - in order to play this DLC.

We are also planning to hold an online score attack competition on the stage of this DLC.
More details will be announced as soon as they are available.

[h3]Adjustment details[/h3]
The invincibility duration of D.Prognosis has been adjusted downwards.
This is due to the fact that both score attacks and quick clears require the player to repeat D.Prognosis using the invincibility time, which we believe is detrimental to gameplay.
We thought about making the bosses more difficult, but in the end there was no other way but to "ignore invincibility", so we decided to modify the bosses downwards.
We apologise for this.

In addition, we may make similar adjustments to the ∀kashic mode, while watching the progress of this adjustment.

notes.title: The full version is now available!
notes.content:
[h1]∀kashicverse -Malicious Wake- innocent record (full version) is now available. [/h1]
We are pleased to announce the release of the full version of ∀kashicverse -Malicious Wak-.
We've been waiting for a long time, but I am relieved that we have managed to deliver it by the end of 2020.
This is thanks to everyone that we were able to successfully complete the project in spite of the difficult times in the social situation.
As we stretched we also achieved all of our plans.
It's still rough around the edges, but we hope you enjoy it.

[h2]Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added end credits.
[*] Added some stories.
[*] Remastered some music.
[*] Adjusted balance and rendering.
[*] Added and fixed documents.
[*] Fixed some bugs.
[*] The story mode has been set to be turned off when first activated.
If you want to see the story mode, you can set it in the options.
[/list]

[h2]Future updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Bugfix
[*] Add DLC
[*] Hold an online score tournament.
[/list]

[h2]Adjustment details[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the controller would not work on the menu screen.
[*] Adjustment of stage 5 difficulty
[/list]


DLC and score attack competitions will be announced in due course.

[h3]Implemented the debug dump function[/h3]
A debug dump function has been implemented to fix a bug that caused the game to crash in stage 2.
This will cause a file named "dump_test-2020-05-31-000000-0-0.dmp" to be generated on the desktop when the game crashes.
If the game crashes, we would appreciate it if you could send us this file.

Send to: Steam community glitch report thread
e-mail: endless.shirafu.vol.2.4747.tx(a)gmail.com

[b]Fixed Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] If you are pushed by an enemy while the J-driver cursor is activated, you can go off screen.
[*] One-stage rate x1000 results will not be unlocked
[*] The English translation of the optional shield opening/closing item is replaced with "HOLD:ON" and "HOLD:OFF".
[/list]


[b]Acknowledgments[/b]

Steam Community helped us a lot in updating the English manual and the story text.
Thank you very much.

notes.title: Update Notice
notes.content:
[h1]Stage 3 is now available. [/h1]

[h2]Updated content[/h2]
[list]
[*] You can now play up to Stage 3!
[*] Added a story in Stage 3.
[*] Adjusted the balance of some bosses.
[*] The English translation has been adjusted by this community.
[*] Many bugs reported here and elsewhere have been fixed.
[/list]


[h2]Future updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Adding and updating story conversations
[*] Improving language problems.
[*] Adjustment and implementation of Stage 4~Stage 5.
[*] Enhanced quality of detail
[/list]

[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] About the operation system
By default, the operation system is the same as Akashicforce's (∀.D.A.M v2 mode), where the method is triggered by entering a key and then pressing a command button.
If you are more familiar with the previous control system (∀.D.A.M v1 mode), you can change it from OPTION.

[*]Steam ranking is now available.
[*] Currently, Story Mode is turned on by default.
In the official release version, it will be turned off by default.
[/list]




Fixed Bugs
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug in which the previous conversation would be carried over if a conversation was started during the stage and observation was stopped and started again.
*] ∀.D.A.M ver.2 Fixed a bug that the derived method does not occur when the key is left in the command completion mode.
*] ∀∀.D.A.M ver.2 Fixed a bug that the method gauge would not be accepted when the method gauge becomes 0 in the antibody region.
[*] Fixed a bug in which some achievements were not connected with those of Steam.
[*] Fixed a bug where Rate would not start at x800 when starting from a boss in Stage Select.
[*] Fixed a bug in which Japanese file names were garbled.
[*] Fixed a bug in DangerPrognosis tutorial that the method does not work in ↓↑.
[*] Fixed a bug in Japanese tutorials where characters were sometimes blurred out.
[*] Fixed a bug in which some items in the ∀kashic record were not reflected when changing the language with OPTION.
[*] Fixed a bug where documents in ∀kashic records scrolled incorrectly after changing the language in OPTION.
[*] Fixed a bug that the left and right arrows that indicate the select do not appear when the difficulty level is selected.
[*] Fixed to synchronize the volume of Endless Syraphrogo with the in-game volume at startup.
[*] Fixing the typo in the document.
[/list]

Known problems (reproduced/unfixed)].
[list]
[*] If you approach an enemy while generating a decoy with Attractant Other, your ship's movement behavior will become strange.
[*] In Shield tutorials, the character's status and description are sometimes conflicting.
[/list]

Known Defects (Not Reappeared)].
[list]
[*] When playing in full screen mode, once the game is in the background, the buttons may be held down when returning to the game.
[*] The key may not respond immediately after the key configuration.
[*] In certain operating environments, the game may be forced to quit after clearing stage 1.
[*] When playing BGM on ∀kashicRecord, the sound disappears below volume 99.
[*] In some ∀kashicRecord sentences, documents may be released under unintended release conditions.
[*] In some cases, the character is pushed out of the screen and cannot be returned to the screen.
[/list]

notes.title: ∀KASHICVERSE -MALICIOUS WAKE- early access version now available on Steam!
notes.content:
[h1]∀KASHICVERSE -MALICIOUS WAKE- early access version now available on Steam![/h1]

[h2]Early access version[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]The basic game systems are fully complete.[/b]
The player character can use all action.
Scenes such as titles and options are fully completed.
[*][b]Stages 1 and 2 are completed. [/b]
We plan 5 stages in total.
[*][b]Steam ranking is not supported.[/b]
It will be supported in the future.
[*][b]Add story mode[/b]
Currently, story mode is ON by default.
In the regular release version, OFF is planned by default.
[/list]

[h2]Upcoming updates[/h2]
[list][*]Add and update story conversation
[*]Improve language issues
[*]Add Stage3, 4, and 5.
[*]Enhance the quality of detail[/list]


[About Input mode]
∀.D.A.M v2 mode ( ∀kashicforce Input mode) is ON by default.
If want to change it to ∀.D.A.M v1 mode (
traditional ∀kashicverse Input mode), can do in OPTION.
